# pbs_roles (Data Source)

Lists the built-in roles of Proxmox Backup Server and their privileges. PBS roles are fixed and cannot be created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the built-in roles and their privileges
data "pbs_roles" "all" {}

output "datastore_backup_privileges" {
  value = one([for r in data.pbs_roles.all.roles : r.privileges if r.role_id == "DatastoreBackup"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) List of roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Description of the role.
- `privileges` (List of String) Privileges granted by the role.
- `role_id` (String) Role name, usable as `role` of `pbs_acl` (e.g. `DatastoreBackup`).
